title: Intelligent Threat Aware Autonomy
solicitation_objective: Advance one or more core ITA2 design challenges, especially WEZ modeling, WEZ avoidance, advanced weaponeering, and mutual-support behaviors for ACPs.
source_basis: DAF 26.BZ Release 1 Phase I topic language, pp. 11-13.
opening_angle: sanity checker for threat-aware autonomy; mission path/constraint assurance layer
delivery: Runtime verification module that checks threat-aware pathing and mission autonomy outputs using a low-compute safety property framework and replay/evaluation tooling.
short_pitch: RTVLAS adapted as a runtime assurance layer for threat-aware autonomy, checking whether generated paths and mission actions remain tactically sane in the presence of dynamic threats and deconfliction constraints.
phase2_transition: Connect to a representative threat-aware planning stack, align with WEZ-aware simulations, and mature real-time interfaces to ACP mission computers.
